rotationSign: CSS rotate(); positive = clockwise on screen

rearing.howTo: Rotate #rear by a NEGATIVE angle (counter-clockwise lifts the front). -35 is a full rear, -20 a small hop, keep within -40..0. Body, head, front legs and tail are inside #rear so they move with it; the hind legs stay planted.
rearing.notes: For a nicer rear also fold the front legs (+35..+55, they are inside #rear so the angle is relative to the body), tip the head +10 and step the hind legs slightly forward (-4..-8). Hind hooves lift about 1-3 px at -8 deg.

parts.description: Far hind leg (darker); pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward). Stays outside 'rear' so it plants the horse when rearing.
Near hind leg; pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward). Stays outside 'rear'.
Wrapper around everything except the hind legs, pivoted at the hips. Rotate NEGATIVE (counter-clockwise) to rear up on the hind legs; the body, head, front legs and tail all move with it.
Far front leg (darker); pivot at the shoulder (+ back/folds under, - reaches forward).
Flowing dark tail; pivot at the root on the rump (+ swings out behind, - tucks in).
Near front leg; pivot at the shoulder (+ back/folds under, - reaches forward).
Neck and head with mane, forelock, ears, blaze; pivot at the base of the neck (+ nods down, - lifts). Neck base hidden behind the body.
Torso; covers the tops of all legs and the neck base. Pivot near the centre for a gentle sway.
